target.text: Un par de piedras en los bolsillos, por si acaso.

translation.text: Couple of rocks in my pockets for good measure.

u.target: Un par de piedras en los bolsillos, por si acaso.

m.english: We want to give you every opportunity to defend yourself.

target.text: Por favor, queremos darle todas las oportunidades de defenderse.

translation.text: We want to give you every opportunity to defend yourself.

m.target: Por favor, queremos darle todas las oportunidades de defenderse.

m.english: We can defend those who can't defend themselves.

target.text: Podemos defender a los que no pueden defenderse.

translation.text: We can defend those who can't defend themselves.

m.target: Podemos defender a los que no pueden defenderse.

m.english: But when we had them, well, it's hard to defend against numbers.

target.text: Pero cuando nosotros las tuvimos, bueno, es difícil defenderse contra el número.

translation.text: But when we had them, well, it's hard to defend against numbers.

m.target: Pero cuando nosotros las tuvimos, bueno, es difícil defenderse contra el número.

m.english: I gave her the capacity to defend herself.

target.text: Le he dado la capacidad de defenderse a sí misma.

translation.text: I gave her the capacity to defend herself.

m.target: Le he dado la capacidad de defenderse a sí misma.

m.english: It's almost upon him, how will he defend himself?

target.text: Es casi encima de él, ¿cómo va a defenderse?

translation.text: It's almost upon him, how will he defend himself?

m.target: Es casi encima de él, ¿cómo va a defenderse?

m.english: We can't have citizens running around able to defend themselves, can we?

target.text: No podemos tener ciudadanos por ahí que sean capaces de defenderse, ¿verdad?

translation.text: We can't have citizens running around able to defend themselves, can we?

m.target: No podemos tener ciudadanos por ahí que sean capaces de defenderse, ¿verdad?

u.english: If everyone is able to defend themselves, what use do they have for me?

target.text: Si todos pueden defenderse solos, ya no me necesitan aquí.

translation.text: If everyone is able to defend themselves, what use do they have for me?

u.target: Si todos pueden defenderse solos, ya no me necesitan aquí.

u.english: But I'm willing to fight for those who cannot fight for themselves.

target.text: Que quiero luchar por quienes no pueden defenderse.

translation.text: But I'm willing to fight for those who cannot fight for themselves.

u.target: Que quiero luchar por quienes no pueden defenderse.

u.english: She should at least be able to defend herself.

target.text: Al menos puede aprender a defenderse de alguien.

translation.text: She should at least be able to defend herself.

u.target: Al menos puede aprender a defenderse de alguien.

u.english: Maybe Sister needs to learn how to throw her hands up like a brother.

target.text: Quizá necesite aprender a defenderse como un hombre.

translation.text: Maybe Sister needs to learn how to throw her hands up like a brother.

u.target: Quizá necesite aprender a defenderse como un hombre.
